label: natural-motion-gates
note: Controlled cases are hand-built native-shaped 20 Hz pictures; native cases replay actual captured native pictures. Both are blended to 60 Hz by WorldViewPlayback.Blend and rendered through ProbeBridge.WorldCommand on the actual rig. Glide: horizontal world speed of the lowest sole point while it is within 3 cm of the standing sole height (supportGlide: only while it is also the lower, weight-bearing foot; a low swing foot is excluded); foot axis: undirected angle foot/travel; knee pole: knee bend direction vs foot direction; chest: shoulder line forward vs received facing. Editor evidence, not a device or GPU measurement.
gateNote: Gates: no skinned sole more than 1 cm below the turf in locomotion; hips/legs/spine joint speed at most 1600 deg/s (about 1.5x the authored sprint cruise) in every window incl. start/stop/turns; thigh change at most 25 deg per 1/60 s; cruise glide of the weight-bearing (lower) sole at most 15 % of the travel speed and 0.25 m/s; no slow (<1.9 m/s) moving frame with both soles (heel, toe base and toe tip) more than 3 cm up in cruise; chest within 15 deg of the received facing and knee pole within 20 deg of the foot on average in cruise; moving hands never above the shoulders or within 0.22 m of the head; steady curves start no turn episode in cruise; the noisy 117 deg boundary switches stride family at most once; captured native locomotion: no sole below the turf and at most 0.5 slow double-float frames per moving second. r3: additionally over the whole fixture and every detected transition window (start/stop, speed change >1.2 m/s in 0.3 s, travel cut or facing change >35 deg in 0.3 s; event -0.35..+0.6 s): root-relative joint speed (received root yaw removed) at most 1600 deg/s, root-relative thigh step at most 25 deg per 1/60 s, no sole below the turf, no hand above the shoulders; captured native locomotion pictures: root-relative joint speed at most 1600 deg/s. The native contact pictures of a foot action (pass/shot 0.09 s, receive/control/tackle 0.12 s from the contact) are reported separately as contactJointRootMax: there the limb meets the received contact point at the native time.

r21GateNote: r21 gates (reported apart from all earlier sets; user defects of 12.10.2026) on the genuine native129 inputs (the R20 contract captures, byte-identical to fresh native129 captures, and further native129 captures): every foul offender window from its first foulOffender picture to 1 s after its last (exit into the following action and walk-off): the lower foot's skinned sole contour (bones without a contour) at most 0.05 m above the turf (no floating offender) and at least -0.02 m; the skinned sole (lowest vertex, every sixth picture) between -0.02 and 0.05 m; the eight bones at most 1600 deg/s (received root yaw removed) and the pelvis at most 1.5 m/s vertically. The float limits apply to the offender pictures (the walk-off is a stride with flight, under the locomotion gates). Every native field player: no run longer than 0.1 s (two received pictures) of display pictures moving at least 1.2 m/s with a Unity backward stride while the received travel is less than FootballLocomotion.BackOff (100 deg) from the received facing (the smoothed travel following a received reversal within one picture). Received reversed travel and kick facing (native/bridge facts, Root) are reported per case, never gated or corrected by Unity.
